links.basis: Refining and petrochemicals are a large part of the business; crude prices move margins and inventory values.
Telecom and retail subsidiaries are large earnings contributors.
Policy rates change lending margins, deposit costs and credit growth.
System-wide loan quality and growth data move all large lenders.
Most revenue is earned in foreign currency and reported in rupees.
Client technology budgets and peer results signal demand.
Cigarettes are the largest profit pool and taxes set their volumes and pricing.
Generation volumes, plant load and fuel availability drive earnings.
Market-wide flows and index moves affect every large constituent.
